description: Figure 16 is a composite group mixing three crystal-structure models with one property plot. Panels (a)-(c) are ball-and-stick renderings of 2x2x2 supercells of the kappa-carbide (Fe3AlC, E21 structure), drawn with light-blue, gold/ochre and small black spheres; the sphere legend printed under (b) assigns blue = Al, gold = Fe, green = Nb, black = C. (a) is the undoped Fe24Al8C8 cell (Al, Fe, C only). (b) is Fe23NbAl8C8, containing a single green Nb sphere sitting at the cube face-centred/body position (the Fe site of Fe3AlC). (c) is Fe24Al7NbC8, with the green Nb sphere placed at a cube corner position (the Al site of Fe3AlC). The fourth panel (bottom-right) is a line plot of Al diffusion coefficient (m^2/s; y-axis 0 to 5x10^-19) versus temperature (K; x-axis 673, 723, 773, 823, 873 K) for two curves, black = 0.02Nb steels and red = 0.04Nb steels, both annotated "Al element". The curves are nearly zero up to ~800 K then rise steeply; at 873 K the red 0.04Nb curve lies slightly above the black 0.02Nb curve. Taken together the panels show the two candidate Nb substitutional sites in the kappa-carbide lattice and the higher Al diffusivity of the higher-Nb steel. No formation-energy values are printed on any panel.

observations.observation: Panels (a)-(c) are ball-and-stick crystal-structure models containing light-blue, gold/yellow and small black spheres, i.e. three distinct atom types in the undoped panel (a).
The legend printed under panel (b) identifies the sphere colours as Al (light blue), Fe (gold), Nb (green) and C (black).
Panel (b) contains exactly one green Nb sphere, positioned near the centre/face of the supercell cube; panels (a) and (c) differ from (b) in the location of the single green sphere.
The caption states panel (a) is the supercell Fe24Al8C8, panel (b) is Fe23NbAl8C8 and panel (c) is Fe24Al7NbC8.
The citing text states that a 2x2x2 atomic supercell was used to model the kappa-carbide (Fe3AlC, E21 structure) for first-principles calculations, as depicted in panel (a).
The citing text states Nb was placed at the face-centred cube position (the Fe site of Fe3AlC) in Figure 16b and at the corner position (the Al site of Fe3AlC) in Figure 16c.
The citing text states the formation energy of the three kappa-carbide structures Fe24Al8C8, Fe23NbAl8C8 and Fe24Al7NbC8 was calculated, but no formation-energy numbers appear on any panel.

The diffusion plot has a y-axis labelled 'Diffusion coefficient (m^2/s)' spanning 0 to 5x10^-19 with gridline ticks at 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 x10^-19, and an x-axis labelled 'Temperature (K)' with ticks at 673, 723, 773, 823 and 873.
Two diffusion curves are plotted: a black line keyed to '0.02Nb steels' and a red line keyed to '0.04Nb steels', with the annotation 'Al element'.
Both diffusion curves remain close to the baseline from 673 K to about 800 K and then rise steeply toward 873 K, where they approach the top of the plotted y-range.
At the high-temperature end (near 873 K) the red 0.04Nb curve lies slightly above the black 0.02Nb curve, while the two curves nearly overlap at the low-temperature end.

subfigures.description: Ball-and-stick 2x2x2 supercell model of the undoped kappa-carbide Fe24Al8C8 (Fe3AlC, E21), showing light-blue, gold and black spheres with no Nb present.
Same supercell with a single green Nb sphere added at the face-centred/body position; a printed legend below defines blue = Al, gold = Fe, green = Nb, black = C. Caption identifies it as Fe23NbAl8C8.
Same supercell with a single green Nb sphere placed at a cube corner position; caption identifies it as Fe24Al7NbC8.
Line plot of Al diffusion coefficient (m^2/s, y = 0 to 5x10^-19) versus temperature (K, x = 673-873) with two curves: black 0.02Nb steels and red 0.04Nb steels, both labelled 'Al element'.

unreadable_items: No numeric formation-energy values for the three kappa-carbide structures are printed anywhere in the group
Caption header text at the top of the figure reads only '(a) (c)' and does not describe the bottom-right diffusion panel, so that panel's caption provenance is unclear
